title: Transonic Buffet Modeling via Invariant Manifolds
summary: In transonic flow over aircraft wings, shock-boundary-layer interactions can give rise to transonic buffet, which degrades maneuverability through unsteady aerodynamic loads. Beyond its practical importance, two-dimensional transonic buffet represents a canonical example of a global instability for which reduced-order modeling remains challenging due to nonlinearity, sharp spatial gradients, and the coexistence of an unstable equilibrium with an attracting limit cycle.
